lyrics:
[Intro: slide guitar phrase, lazy disco beat, round bass]

[Verse 1: soft relaxed male voice]
Band's packing up, the lights are low
You've got your shoes off, good to go
I cross the deck, I clear my throat
Same as that night on your daddy's boat

[Chorus: full groove, harmonies, slide guitar answering]
I'm still asking
May I have this one?
Thirty years of yes
And I still don't assume
Still asking
Come on, the night's still young

[Verse 2: voice warmer]
You roll your eyes, you take my hand
You say, "You know you don't have to ask, old man"
I know I don't. That's why I do.
It's the best part of dancing with you.

[Chorus: full groove, harmonies, slide guitar answering]
I'm still asking
May I have this one?
Thirty years of yes
And I still don't assume
Still asking
Come on, the night's still young

[Instrumental: slide guitar solo, handclaps]

[Outro: groove, bare feet on stone, "Yes."]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 104 BPM, 4/4, D major. A lazy, warm daytime-disco sway.

VOICE: Male, soft, light and unhurried, sung almost under his breath with a smile. Gentle harmonies in the choruses. One spoken word, hers, at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: A slide guitar playing long, sweet phrases, a round, melodic bass guitar, a soft disco kick and hi-hat, a clean rhythm guitar, electric piano, congas, handclaps.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, slide guitar. 0:18 Verse 1. 0:50 Chorus 1. 1:22 Verse 2. 1:54 Chorus 2. 2:26 Slide guitar solo. 2:58 Outro groove and 'Yes' at 3:30.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2010s Californian daytime disco: warm, soft-edged and analogue, bass and slide guitar in front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'I know I don't. That's why I do.' at 1:40.

STATION FIT: Saturday, 7 p.m. A slow-dance track in the style of the act whose name the station nearly shares.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Courteous, teasing, tender, dancing.
